Since its inception, our slogan has been “Our Business Experiences make the differences” and within a short time, the company has earned business respects in area of telecommunication engineering business in the country. 
     

            
    



We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Office Support Associate

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-Time

Description


	Are you smart, tech-savvy, proactive, and ready to build your career in a fast-paced work environment? This could be your next opportunity!
	OKK Global Resources Limited is looking for a young professional to join our team as an Office Support Associate.


What You’ll Do


	Set up laptops and basic IT equipment for new employees.
	Provide first-level troubleshooting and resolve minor laptop/software issues.
	Support the purchase, replacement, and maintenance of laptops and office equipment.
	Coordinate with vendors and suppliers when necessary.
	Support staff onboarding and general office operations.
	Assist with other administrative and office support functions.


What We’re Looking For


	HND/Bachelor’s Degree in IT, computer science, business administration, office administration, or a related field.
	A minimum of 1 year of relevant work experience.
	Must have completed NYSC.
	Basic knowledge of laptop setup, software installation, and troubleshooting.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
	Smart, organized, resourceful, and a quick learner.
	Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
	Strong willingness to learn and grow.


Why Join Us?


	This is more than an office support role — it is an opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to IT support, procurement, administration, and business operations while growing your professional career.


Method of Application

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "WASH Consultant Engineer",
  "description": "Nina Jojer Limited is a Pan-African consulting firm committed to empowering transformation in Africa by providing innovative solutions to businesses, governments, and organizations. Our core services include provision of HR solutions, Policy Development, Strategic Advisory, Stakeholder Management and Advocacy, Digital Transformation, and Data-Driven Insights. We are dedicated to driving impact and fostering long-term growth for our clients.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: WASH Consultant Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The WASH sector in Nigeria is committed to accelerating progress towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by ensuring equitable access to safe, inclusive, and sustainable WASH services. Beyond expanding access, there is an increasing focus on strengthening WASH services in institutions, particularly schools and primary health care (PHC) facilities, as these are essential for improving education, health outcomes, infection prevention and control (IPC), nutrition, and overall well-being.
	Despite progress made over the years, significant gaps remain in the availability, functionality, accessibility, and sustainability of WASH services in schools and PHC facilities.
